title: GBU-Palm: A Multimodal Video Dataset and Benchmark for Palm Presentation Attack Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.14389v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing palm presentation attack detection (PAD) datasets are often limited by static imagery, restricted acquisition conditions, or insufficient multimodal video data, hindering systematic evaluation across environments, modalities, and attack types. We present GBU-Palm, a large-scale multimodal video dataset and benchmark containing 21,326 videos from 105 subjects and 210 palms across six acquisition environments, including bona fide, Print, and Replay presentations, with 6,310 synchronized RGB-NIR samples. We construct leakage-controlled protocols that separate palm identity and attack lineage and benchmark four representative video architectures under environment-matched and held-out-environment settings. Results reveal substantial architecture-dependent degradation under environmental shift and show that RGB-NIR fusion does not consistently outperform RGB-only input. translated_title: GBU-Palm：用于手掌呈现攻击检测的多模态视频数据集与基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14389v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：现有手掌呈现攻击检测（PAD）数据集通常受限于静态图像、受限采集条件或不足的多模态视频数据，阻碍了跨环境、跨模态和跨攻击类型的系统评估。我们提出了GBU-Palm，一个大规模多模态视频数据集和基准，包含来自105名受试者和210只手掌的21,326个视频，涵盖六种采集环境，包括真实、打印和重放呈现，并配有6,310个同步RGB-NIR样本。我们构建了泄漏控制协议，分离手掌身份和攻击来源，并在环境匹配和保留环境设置下评估了四种代表性视频架构。结果揭示了环境变化下显著的架构依赖性退化，并表明RGB-NIR融合并不始终优于仅RGB输入。我们进一步通过真实接受率（TA）和真实拒绝率（TR）分析模型行为。
tldr: 该论文提出了GBU-Palm，一个包含21,326个多模态视频的大规模手掌呈现攻击检测数据集和基准，揭示了环境变化下架构依赖的性能退化，并发现RGB-NIR融合并非始终优于RGB-only输入。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GBU-Palm, a large-scale multimodal video dataset and benchmark for palm presentation attack detection with 21,326 videos, revealing architecture-dependent performance degradation under environmental shift and showing that RGB-NIR fusion does not consistently outperform RGB-only input.
